sources.title: GitHub - serengil/retinaface: RetinaFace: Deep Face Detection Library ...
sources.snippet: RetinaFace RetinaFace is a deep learning based cutting-edge facial detector for Python coming with facial landmarks. Its detection performance is amazing even in the crowd as shown in the following illustration. RetinaFace is the face detection module of insightface project. The original implementation is mainly based on mxnet.

sources.title: RetinaFace - Accurate AI Face Detection & Facial Analysis
sources.snippet: RetinaFace is an advanced AI face detection model that delivers accurate facial landmark recognition, face alignment, and facial analysis for computer vision applications.
